binding_rules: no discovery result may replace Arm D directly
any promising formulation must later become a NEW frozen challenger under a separate registered evaluation
preserve all null and negative results
feature_gate.audit() must pass before any fit

ws1_repaired_projected_role.basketball_mechanism: turnover rate changes most when a player occupies a substantially DIFFERENT offensive role than normal, not simply because the role is large
ws1_repaired_projected_role.exact_formulation: projected minutes share ONLY (never both shares); trailing minutes share; projected minus trailing; rotation-rank change; bounded transform for a materially expanded role; linear plus ONE preregistered bounded nonlinear form (positive/negative role-change split)
ws1_repaired_projected_role.expected_direction: role CHANGE positive on turnover rate; role LEVEL near null once change is included
ws1_repaired_projected_role.data_and_provenance: projected_player_possessions/1 tier_a_only; master_player minutes, strictly prior games
ws1_repaired_projected_role.supports_hypothesis: role-change coefficient stable across folds AND operational team MAE not worse than D
ws1_repaired_projected_role.falsifies_or_weakens: change term null once level is included, or the gain is confined to one season
ws1_repaired_projected_role.known_confounders: projected minutes share is a deterministic transform of the exposure offset; role change correlates with injury context
ws1_repaired_projected_role.metrics: operational team MAE vs D; intrinsic deviance; season stability

ws2_responsibility_transfer.basketball_mechanism: turnovers rise specifically for players positioned to ABSORB missing teammates offensive responsibility
ws2_responsibility_transfer.exact_formulation: three frozen constructions: (1) team_displaced_involvement x player_prior_involvement; (2) allocated displaced load proportional to prior creation share; (3) allocated load x projected-role expansion
ws2_responsibility_transfer.expected_direction: positive interaction; the player-specific form beats the team-level H arm
ws2_responsibility_transfer.data_and_provenance: P2 feature artifact; frozen prior involvement; tier_a_only candidates
ws2_responsibility_transfer.supports_hypothesis: a player-specific transfer form beats team-level displaced_involvement on operational team MAE
ws2_responsibility_transfer.falsifies_or_weakens: no construction beats H, or gains appear only under oracle appearance
ws2_responsibility_transfer.known_confounders: absences correlate with opponent quality and with the absent player own rate
ws2_responsibility_transfer.metrics: operational team MAE vs D and vs H; player deviance

ws3_team_total_plus_allocation.basketball_mechanism: one model should not have to control BOTH how many turnovers a team commits AND which players commit them
ws3_team_total_plus_allocation.exact_formulation: stage 1 team-total count model on projected team possessions; stage 2 compositional allocation (multinomial / Dirichlet-multinomial / softmax shares with shrinkage) summing EXACTLY to the stage-1 total
ws3_team_total_plus_allocation.expected_direction: allocation improves player identity WITHOUT harming the team total; G becomes useful in the allocation layer
ws3_team_total_plus_allocation.supports_hypothesis: team-total accuracy at least matching the D aggregate AND player allocation deviance improving
ws3_team_total_plus_allocation.falsifies_or_weakens: the allocation gain requires sacrificing team-total accuracy
ws3_team_total_plus_allocation.known_confounders: team total and allocation share a common exposure error
ws3_team_total_plus_allocation.metrics: team-total MAE; allocation deviance; share calibration; both jointly

ws4_ewma_timescale_family.basketball_mechanism: one decay rate cannot suit both stable and unstable roles
ws4_ewma_timescale_family.exact_formulation: effective-half-life family: slow long-memory; incumbent alpha=0.10; fast role-responsive; dual short+long timescale; role-change-GATED decay. Nested chronological development folds only
ws4_ewma_timescale_family.expected_direction: faster adaptation helps after role shifts and team changes; slow decay remains better for stable roles
ws4_ewma_timescale_family.data_and_provenance: P1 target artifact; strictly prior games
ws4_ewma_timescale_family.supports_hypothesis: a gated or dual-timescale variant beats alpha=0.10 in unstable-role strata AND does not lose in stable strata
ws4_ewma_timescale_family.falsifies_or_weakens: no variant beats the incumbent anywhere, or gains vanish out of fold
ws4_ewma_timescale_family.known_confounders: role instability correlates with injury and with low support
ws4_ewma_timescale_family.metrics: by-stratum deviance and team MAE; post-trade and post-role-shift subsets

ws5_opportunity_proxies.basketball_mechanism: FGA share is an incomplete proxy for ball-handling responsibility
ws5_opportunity_proxies.exact_formulation: bounded set: FGA share; play-ending involvement (FGA + frozen FT weight x FTA + turnovers); share of team play-ending involvement; short vs long involvement change; involvement rank among projected teammates; projected responsibility share after removing unavailable teammates
ws5_opportunity_proxies.expected_direction: play-ending involvement beats FGA share as a rate predictor and especially as an allocation weight
ws5_opportunity_proxies.data_and_provenance: master_player fga and fta; canonical turnover targets; strictly prior games
ws5_opportunity_proxies.supports_hypothesis: a proxy improves the conditional rate OR allocation beyond the P1 EWMA
ws5_opportunity_proxies.falsifies_or_weakens: all proxies are redundant with the P1 EWMA turnover rate
ws5_opportunity_proxies.known_confounders: involvement is mechanically related to turnovers because turnovers enter the play-ending formula
ws5_opportunity_proxies.metrics: conditional rate deviance; allocation weight quality; redundancy with D

ws6_mechanism_decomposition.basketball_mechanism: bad passes relate to creation burden; lost balls to handling pressure; offensive fouls to drives; travels to role instability; shot-clock violations are team or lineup driven
ws6_mechanism_decomposition.exact_formulation: diagnostics plus bounded discovery models per mechanism: base rate, support, source-schema stability, player concentration, relation to involvement and to role change, contribution to total-model error
ws6_mechanism_decomposition.expected_direction: the G player-level gain and team-level loss arise from OFFSETTING mechanism effects
ws6_mechanism_decomposition.supports_hypothesis: involvement helps one mechanism and hurts another with opposite signs
ws6_mechanism_decomposition.falsifies_or_weakens: all mechanisms respond to involvement in the same direction
ws6_mechanism_decomposition.known_confounders: mechanism mix differs by source schema, which is confounded with season type
ws6_mechanism_decomposition.metrics: per-mechanism deviance and error contribution; NO promotion

ws7_nonlinear_heterogeneous.basketball_mechanism: role and involvement effects may be hidden by linear pooling
ws7_nonlinear_heterogeneous.exact_formulation: piecewise-linear; splines with few preregistered knots; separate expansion vs contraction effects; involvement x projected minutes; involvement x historical support; partial pooling by continuous role tier derived WITHIN each training fold. No unrestricted player-specific slopes
ws7_nonlinear_heterogeneous.expected_direction: the effect concentrates among primary creators and among secondary creators receiving expanded roles
ws7_nonlinear_heterogeneous.supports_hypothesis: a bounded nonlinear form beats the linear term out of fold in a preregistered stratum
ws7_nonlinear_heterogeneous.falsifies_or_weakens: linear and nonlinear indistinguishable, or gains only in fold
ws7_nonlinear_heterogeneous.known_confounders: role tiers correlate with support; low-support players are noisier
ws7_nonlinear_heterogeneous.metrics: stratum-wise deviance and operational team MAE

ws8_operational_error_decomposition.basketball_mechanism: where does operational error actually come from: availability, candidate precision, minute allocation, possession allocation, or rate
ws8_operational_error_decomposition.exact_formulation: hold Arm D fixed; five LABELLED diagnostic counterfactuals: (1) full operational; (2) oracle appearance with exposure reallocated among actual participants; (3) Tier A plus actual missing participants; (4) oracle minutes or possessions; (5) realised exposure
ws8_operational_error_decomposition.data_and_provenance: projected exposure artifact; realised possessions; targets
ws8_operational_error_decomposition.supports_hypothesis: a clear ordering of incremental error contributions
ws8_operational_error_decomposition.falsifies_or_weakens: contributions are diffuse and none dominates
ws8_operational_error_decomposition.known_confounders: oracle variants are NOT models and are never promotion evidence
ws8_operational_error_decomposition.metrics: incremental team MAE change per counterfactual step
